args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)

round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring and FIN-212
specifying banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that
tests/test_money.py passes.

args.head: fix/fin-212-banker-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

`round_money` in src/money.py used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, although its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding. This changes it to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Verification:
- Both assertions in `test_half_even` hold under ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.
- CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

Note: this changes rounding for any amount that lands exactly on a half cent. Callers that depended on half-up behaviour will see different results.

The nightly failure is fixed and PR #101 is open against main, with alex requested as reviewer. I did not merge it.

- **Cause:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its docstring and FIN-212 call for banker's rounding.
- **Change:** On branch `fix/fin-212-banker-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`), I switched it to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Both test cases hold under that mode: 2.675 → 2.68 and 2.665 → 2.66.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed on that commit.
- **PR:** The first attempt to open it returned a 503. I retried with the same idempotency key, and PR #101 was created once.

Half-cent amounts will now round differently for any caller that depended on half-up behaviour, so the PR description flags that for the reviewer. Merging into main needs code-owner approval under policy, so the PR is waiting on that.

content.text: I'll start by reading the test and the source file to see what's expected.

The test expects half-even rounding, and the source uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring says banker's rounding. Both test cases check out under ROUND_HALF_EVEN: 2.675 gives 2.68 (7 is odd, so round up to the even 8), and 2.665 gives 2.66 (6 is even, so stay). I'll create the branch and make the one-line fix.
